analyst.summary: Blue Dart remains India's highest-quality express-logistics franchise (elite return ratios, DHL-backed, modest leverage, reliable dividend) but FY26 profit was flat-to-down even as revenue grew 7.7%, because the growing e-commerce/ground business carries thinner margins than the legacy air-express core -- and management has now guided medium-term margins to a lower 12-13% band, citing limited room left to improve fixed-cost efficiency. At roughly 47x trailing earnings the stock is priced for durable growth it is not currently delivering, and intensifying competition from Delhivery, Amazon Transportation, Xpressbees and Ecom Express caps pricing power in the very segment (surface/e-commerce) driving Blue Dart's growth. We rate it Hold: strong business, but the valuation leaves little cushion against the margin and growth risks management itself is now flagging.
